scope: Unadmitted exploratory Hammer prototype. New numeric design, not reconstruction, production validation or human balance. No heldout runs in phase one.

timing.normalDecisionCadence: Unchanged 5 + random()*3 seconds; two construction/upgrade attempts; ordinary separate citadel/Volley checks.

supportScore.healthEquivalent: hp / bound unit base hp; production levels count only living forward producers; foundries never add support score.

eligibility: At least one living forward warrior/Rootwarden producer and one living forward archery range on candidate road; every other road retains living forward mobile production. New foundry behind screen; cap two living foundries overall.
activation: Successful ordinary foundry build. A later turn to an existing foundry requires an ordinary paid foundry upgrade; if already maxed, a paid screen/range upgrade or an additional needed screen/range producer may finance that turn. No fabricated turn if no useful legal paid investment remains.
collapse: At ordinary AI decision only: last committed-road foundry destroyed, OR last forward screen producer lost, OR last forward archery range lost. Losing one of several category members does not collapse it. Clear lane/lock and start 20s cooldown. No producer remaining means ordinary paid reconstruction can continue during cooldown, but no siege reselection until it expires and full support eligibility is restored.
lockVersusCooldown: Lock prevents discretionary switching for 45s after a funded commitment while allowing paid emergency defense. Cooldown prevents new selection for 20s after actual collapse; it is not an extra lock and grants nothing.
turnCriteria: After lock expiry, challenger score at least current score+2; unsupported current road first collapses. No forced periodic change. Title means opportunity to turn paid investment; not guaranteed alternating waves.
restore: Restore copies validated state and RNG only; neither restore nor emergency calls selection out of normal scheduling, grants actions, resets timers or changes treasury.
warning: Foundry becomes visible immediately; ordinary first spawn about1.2s later plus normal travel. No construction countdown.
evidenceBoundary: Outcome runs use production APIs only after disclosed authored setup; all failed runs retained. Full action/income/bounty/refund ledger. Runtime plus actual simulator/evaluator/policy/config dependency closure is distinct from full repository integrity. Heldouts forbidden in phase one.

preExplorationAmendments.reason: Independent WIP001 review found second-producer count alone insufficient and impossible emergency build blocked all spending. No outcome or heldout run preceded these changes.
preExplorationAmendments.secondSupportProducer: Only genuinely unmet current local demand: ground health equivalents > own screen equivalents for a second screen, air health equivalents > own archer equivalents for a second range. Same-road maxed foundry and all ordinary turn conditions required.
preExplorationAmendments.fullRoadEmergency: Prefer a legal useful on-road defensive upgrade when new construction has no legal site; if neither exists, skip the impossible emergency rather than block all spending. No extra action or reset.

preExplorationAmendments.reason: Independent WIP001 review found malformed early absolute deadlines admitted. No outcome run preceded this fix.
preExplorationAmendments.saveAdmission: Nonzero absolute lock deadline must be >=900 and cooldown deadline >=400, and within current tick plus its duration. Expired legitimate deadlines remain admitted; no reconstruction or selection occurs on restore.
